name: rutorrent-dracula-theme
description: Development tooling for the Dracula theme for ruTorrent. Nothing here ships — the theme is the Dracula/ folder, copied into ruTorrent as it is.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.deploy:older: npm run deploy:5.2.0 && npm run deploy:5.1.12
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run deploy
scripts.verify:older: npm run check && npm run deploy:older
